title: Assemble BFF main.py composition root and retire legacy handlers (Training V3 dependency replacement)
summary_zh: 以 Training V3 正確依賴重建 BFF main.py composition root，掛載所有具名 domain router，刪除已遷移 legacy handlers 與 read_store.py。

owned: Reconstruct BFF main.py into a pure composition root that includes all domain routers without direct @app route decorators
Delete read_store.py and ensure zero production callers/imports remain
Verify clean router assembly, 0 static route shadowing, and 0 route collisions across all mounted domain routers
not_changing: Predecessor domain routers already delivered across Waves 1-3
Core business logic encapsulated within domain service modules

root_cause.summary: Historical BFF main.py contained legacy inline route decorators and read_store.py was superseded by ports namespace and domain router packages.
root_cause.observed: main.py had legacy inline route definitions and residual references to read_store.py.
